description: This Java class, MavenWrapperDownloader, handles downloading a specific version of the Maven wrapper JAR file based on properties specified in a config file. It reads configuration properties, determines the download URL, manages directory creation, and performs the file download.

classes.name: MavenWrapperDownloader
classes.description: Main class responsible for downloading the Maven wrapper JAR based on configuration, including handling properties, directory creation, and file download.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes download process, reads configuration, resolves URL, manages directories, and calls the download function.

methods.name: downloadFileFromURL
methods.description: Handles downloading a file from a provided URL and saving it to the specified destination on disk.
